# dsh-composer-draft-cache · 输入框增强（草稿缓存 + @插件）
DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的输入框增强插件，包含两个能力：

1. **草稿缓存**：记住尚未发出的输入框草稿，切走再回来时自动填回；已发送或手动清空的草稿不会重新出现。
2. **`@` 插件提及**：在输入框里输入 `@` 即可选择已安装的社区插件（而不是只
能 @ 文件/会话）；选中后会插入一个原子引用，Agent 本轮会被明确告知"用户指定使用该插件"，并收到该插件的名称与说明。例如：`@ui-ux 设计插件的标题 帮我做这个页面的 UI/UE 设计`
@ 文件/会话）；选中后会插入一个原子引用，Agent 本轮会被明确告知"用户指定使用该插件"，并收到该插件的名称与说明。例如：`@ui-ux 设计插件的标题 帮我做这个页面的 UI/UE 设计`。
A DeepSeek Harness composer-enhancement bundle with two features:

- **Draft cache** — keeps unsent composer drafts and puts them back when you
return: per workspace f

or "new session" composers (each workspace's *new
session* action opens a fresh blank Session), and

per Session id for
already-created ("historical") Sessions. Sending or deliberately clearing a
draft

removes its entry immediately, so submitted content never returns.
- **`@plugin` mentions** — typin

g `@` in the composer now offers one more
completion group: the installed community plugins, next to

files and
Sessions. Picking one inserts an atomic mention chip; the Host half reads the
mention fro

m the accepted user message and publishes the selected plugin's
metadata as bounded runtime context,

so the model knows the user explicitly
chose that plugin for this turn.
## Features
### Draft cache

- **Headless**: registers one entry in the `conversation.input.dock` slot that
always renders `null`

; no visual footprint, no layout change.
- **Two scopes**: workspace key while the Session is still

a new/blank Session,
Session-id key once the Session has started.
- **Never resurrects sent text**:

the restore predicate requires that this mount
has not seen any text yet (`sawText`); once text was

seen, an empty composer
means send/clear and the entry is deleted instead of restored. Extra guards

discard a new-session entry when its source Session already attempted a prompt
(`promptAttempted`) o

r is no longer blank.
- **Performance**: composer state is read through primitive selectors
(`draft`

/ attachment count / submit phase) with `Object.is` equality, so
unrelated store publishes (queue,

occurrences, claim, uploads) neither
re-render the component nor re-run its effect. No timers, DOM w

rites, or
per-render allocations.
- **Storage**: in-memory map + `sessionStorage` mirror under
`dsh.

composer-draft-cache.v1:` (`workspace:<path>` / `session:<id>` keys).
Survives a page reload, discar

ded when the app window closes; never writes to
the Host or the Session log.
### `@plugin` mentions

- **Composer menu**: a second `@` source (`plugin`) lists enabled community
plugins from the Host `p

luginInventory` Remote, newest snapshot cached for a
few seconds; the live query filters by title, m

odule name and description.
Core `@deepseek-ai/*` platform rows are not listed — only plugins you
in

stalled on top of the harness.
- **Atomic mention chip**: a pick inserts `@Title`
as an atomic refer

ence (source `plugin`), displayed as `@ Title`; the
hand-typed shortcut `@plugin:<package name>` wor

ks too.
- **Model effect**: on `agent/pre-step` the Host half collects mentions from the
accepted us

er messages, keeps them for the turn (later tool-call steps keep
the same selection), and publishes

a bounded `## User-selected plugins`
block through `ctx.systemPrompt.context()`: display title, pack

age name,
Loader entry id and description, plus the instruction that the user asked to
use that plug

in and that non-existent capabilities must not be invented.
Unknown/disabled packages are reported i

nstead of guessed.
- **Sent-message rendering**: a `userText` rule and a
`conversation.user.text.nod

e` renderer show the mention as a compact inline
chip in Chat instead of raw Markdown.
## Compatibility

Built and verified against DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (Desktop profile).
Uses documented extens

ied against DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (Desktop profile).
Uses documented extension seams only:

- Client: `slots`, `inputTriggers.registerSource`, `uiConversation.userText`,
`remote.pluginInventor

y`, `locale`.
- Host: `loader`, `systemPrompt.context`, the `agent/pre-step` waterfall
(returns the
downstream decision unchanged and only records the selection).

It does not import Harness Client packages; UI styling uses `--dsw-alias-*`
theme tokens only.
## Install

1. Put this directory anywhere on disk (e.g. a workspace folder).
2. Install it as a profile bundle

through the Plugin Manager, or with the
`plugin_manager` tool:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

3. Refresh the Web GUI once. Verify the live registration: the
`composer-draft-cache` entry appears

in `conversation.input.dock`, and the
`plugin` entry in `conversation.user.text.node`.
## Usage

- Type into a workspace's "new session" composer, switch to another workspace,
then open that worksp

ace's "new session" again — the draft is back.
- Type into any Session, switch away and return — tha

t Session's draft is back.
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations

- Drafts containing reference/command chips are restored as their plain
clipboard text; attached ima

ges/files are not restored.
- The draft cache lives with the browser page: closing the app window cl

ears it.
- `@plugin` completion lists Loader-visible plugins (a community plugin needs at
least one

Host row, which every `dsh.bundle` patch normally inserts). A
client-only package without a Host row

is not listed; hand-typing its exact
package name still reaches the model as a mention but without

injected
metadata.
- The mention selection applies while its turn runs; a later turn without any
men

tion clears it.
- The `@` source registers under `plugin`; on a page that went through several
hot r

eloads of this plugin it may fall back to `plugins` / `plugin-mentions`
(and the two extra names exi

st as serializer aliases). A normal page reload
restores the preferred name.
